function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician who has been active mainly in the state of Telangana. He first rose to prominence as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), winning a seat in the Lok Sabha from the Nalgonda constituency in 2014. During that term he served as Minister of State for Rural Development (Independent Charge).

In 2019 he resigned from his ministerial post amid allegations of corruption and subsequently left the BJP. In 2020 he was briefly detained on charges related to bribery, though he was released on bail. After leaving the BJP, he joined the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) in 2021 and contested the 2022 state assembly elections from the Yellandu constituency, although he did not win.

He has a background in agriculture and has been involved in various rural development initiatives during his tenure in government.
